# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Applied the pending baseline-harness amendments by adding explicit artifact labels to harness runs and metadata, hardening envelope checks so constrained floating-point metrics fail on NaN/Inf, widening scenario nitrate envelopes to preserve qualitative source-water-aware behavior, and splitting shrimp egg bookkeeping so malformed cohorts are repaired only at save-load boundaries while runtime invariants now fail fast on mismatches. Updated the baseline e2e suite to avoid artifact collisions, document the widened NO3 reasoning, replace the synthetic reproduction baseline with a public-startup berried-window fixture plus a clearly labeled controlled-ideal hatch-path test, and made the small scenario/core compile-fix updates needed to keep the affected packages building for targeted validation.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Reviewed the pending amendments against the existing harness, baseline e2e suite, and shrimp invariant/save-load paths to identify the concrete code and test changes needed.
2. [Completed] Patched the harness and scenario tests to add artifact labels, finite-value envelope guards, broader source-water-aware NO3 envelopes, and separated public-startup reproduction coverage from the controlled-ideal hatch-path regression.
3. [Completed] Moved shrimp egg-cohort repair to load-time normalization, made runtime invariant enforcement reject bookkeeping mismatches, added targeted regression coverage, and applied the small compile-fix updates required for affected packages.
4. [Completed] Ran formatting and targeted package/test validation, then recorded the remaining full-package validation blocker caused by unrelated merge-conflict files.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test validation` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_baseline_scenarios -- --nocapture` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core` could not complete because unrelated unresolved merge markers remain in the worktree, including `crates/tank_core/src/systems/plant_growth.rs`.

## Outstanding Risks

- Full `cargo test -p tank_core` validation is still blocked by unrelated unresolved merge-conflict markers in the worktree, notably `crates/tank_core/src/systems/plant_growth.rs`, so only targeted `tank_core` suites were run.
- The new public-startup shrimp fixture preserves current v0.1 behavior as a berried-window plus egg-failure baseline; natural juvenile hatching still does not occur under normal mortality/starting-state semantics, so hatch mechanics are only guarded by the separate controlled-ideal test.
- The repository remains in a dirty merge state with unrelated `UU` files outside this bead, which increases integration risk until those conflicts are resolved.
